compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: LMV321IDBVR assigns 1IN+ (IN_POS) whereas TLV9061IDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VEE pin (GND vs V-).
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: LMV321IDBVR assigns 1IN- (IN_NEG) whereas TLV9061IDBVR assigns IN+ (IN_POS) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 4: LMV321IDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) whereas TLV9061IDBVR assigns IN- (IN_NEG) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VCC pin (VCC+ vs V+).

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Soldering TLV9061IDBVR onto a LMV321IDBVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (LMV321IDBVR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=RR vs TLV9061IDBVR: IN=RR, OUT=RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.

CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 10x (LMV321IDBVR: 1 MHz p.7 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 10 MHz p.13); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 6.5x (LMV321IDBVR: 1 V/µs p.7 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 6.5 V/µs p.13); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 30000x (LMV321IDBVR: 15000 pA p.7 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 0.5 pA p.13); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 4.1x (LMV321IDBVR: 130 µA/ch p.7 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 538 µA/ch p.14); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LMV321IDBVR requires Vs,min >= 2.7 V (p.5) vs 1.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: LMV321IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TLV9061IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 1 MHz (p.7) vs 10 MHz (p.13), supply ceiling 5.5 V (p.5) vs 5.5 V (p.10), Vos 7 mV (p.7) vs 1.6 mV (p.13), Ib 30000x gap (15000 vs 0.5 pA), voltage noise 39 vs 16 nV/√Hz. Primary bench gotchas to watch: LMV321IDBVR "CRITICAL SOT-23-5 Pinout Mismatch vs TLV9001IDBVR, TLV9061IDBVR, OPA333AIDBVR, and TLV3201AIDBVR" (p.3) and TLV9061IDBVR "SOT-23-5 (DBV) Pinout Matches TLV9001/OPA333 DBV — Differs from SC70 (DCK) & U-Variants" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose LMV321IDBVR when ultra-low supply current (130 µA/ch) is prioritized; choose TLV9061IDBVR when closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 10 MHz GBWP or DC precision demands <= 1.6 mV max Vos. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.5) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
